disclaimer: Not production data. Not eligibility advice. No automatic publish. Import only after human editorial approval.

verified_ready_for_editorial_review.summary: Temporary resident pathway for international students at designated learning institutions, subject to IRCC requirements including acceptance letter, identity, funds, and in most cases a provincial/territorial attestation letter.

requirements.text: Letter of acceptance from a designated learning institution (when required).
Provincial or territorial attestation letter (PAL/TAL), or CAQ for Quebec, in most cases.
Proof of identity (passport or travel document).
Proof of funds for tuition and living expenses as required by IRCC for the situation.

steps.title: Confirm whether a study permit is required
steps.description: Use IRCC guidance to determine if a study permit is needed for the intended program length and situation.

steps.title: Gather required documents
steps.description: Collect acceptance letter, attestation letter/CAQ when applicable, identity documents, and proof of funds per current IRCC document list.

steps.title: Apply online via IRCC secure account
steps.description: Submit the study permit application online using the IRCC secure account process in force at the time of application.

verified_ready_for_editorial_review.notes: Processing times and fees intentionally omitted — they change frequently and must be linked live to IRCC tools, not frozen in seed data.

verified_ready_for_editorial_review.summary: IRCC electronic system that manages applications for certain economic permanent residence programs. Candidates create a profile and may receive an invitation to apply based on ranking and program eligibility. This is not a single visa subclass.

requirements.text: Meet the minimum requirements of at least one Express Entry program (e.g. CEC, FSW, FST) as published by IRCC at application time.
Provide language test results that are less than two years old when required by IRCC.

steps.title: Review program-specific eligibility on IRCC
steps.description: Confirm which Express Entry program(s) may apply; requirements differ by program.

steps.title: Create Express Entry profile
steps.description: Create a profile in the IRCC system and enter the pool if eligible.

verified_ready_for_editorial_review.notes: CRS point tables and proof-of-funds amounts are not frozen in this package.

requires_professional_review.reason: Thresholds are program-specific and change; hard-coding as product rules requires legal/editorial sign-off.
IRCC updates settlement fund tables periodically; must not be snapshotted as static eligibility.

missing_evidence.reason: No verified multi-destination package in v1; expand only with official authority URLs.
Institutional fees and awards not verified for product seed; catalog remains empty-safe.
